questions.question: A sample DEA number is AB123456?. What is the check digit using the common DEA checksum method?
questions.explanation: Odd positions: 1+3+5=9. Even positions: (2+4+6)×2=24. Total 33, so the check digit is 3. A checksum match alone does not establish registration validity.

questions.question: A pharmacy buys a product for $30 and sells it for $40. What is the percent markup based on acquisition cost?
questions.explanation: Markup on cost is ($40−$30)/$30×100=33.3%. This is not the profit margin.

questions.question: A pharmacy buys a product for $30 and sells it for $40. What is the gross profit margin as a percentage of selling price?
questions.explanation: Gross margin is ($40−$30)/$40×100=25%. Markup on cost would be 33.3%.

questions.question: Each bottle has an exact capacity of 1 US fluid ounce (29.57 mL). How many bottles are needed to contain all 150 mL without exceeding each bottle's capacity?
questions.explanation: 150÷29.57≈5.073. Whole bottles must round up to 6. This differs from treating 1 fl oz as approximately 30 mL.
